# Buildwise Studios — AI Staffing for Professional Services

> Buildwise Studios staffs AI agents into professional services firms — narrow roles, monthly retainer, measured KPIs. Each agent is a hire, not a project. The home hub routes visitors to live vertical landing pages or Jason scoping for custom industries.

We place specialized agents into defined roles — not generic chatbots you prompt. Live today: executive search intelligence agents and Hong Kong legal workflow agents. If your industry is not listed, Jason (our AI scoping agent) maps workflows in about ten minutes for a custom proposal — but the model is the same: audit, pilot, monthly retainer.

## Verticals

- [Executive Search](https://buildwise-studios.com/ai-agents-for-headhunting-professionals/llms.txt): Intelligence agents for headhunting firms — market moves, CRM, and admin off the partner's plate
- [Hong Kong Legal](https://buildwise-studios.com/hong-kong-legal-agents/llms.txt): Workflow agents for HK law firms, in-house teams, and businesses — contract triage, review, and deadlines
